scoring_justification: DFT CI-NEB cannot be re-run in the verifier sandbox (T1 infeasible). Energy barriers are result-compared to paper-reported gold with absolute tolerance. Selectivities are additionally recomputed from submitted barriers via the Arrhenius equation (k_B=8.617×10⁻⁵ eV/K, T=300 K) to verify internal physical consistency — this is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported energy barriers and selectivities for He, Ne, Ar permeation through -6% biaxial strained CN monolayer
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text Section 3.2: 'the barrier for He, Ne and Ar is further increased to 0.11, 0.51 and 2.45 eV' and Table 2: 'S(He/Ne) = 5.17 × 10⁶, S(He/Ar) = 1.89 × 10³⁹'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported numerical results; no synthesis or derivation needed
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact values the paper claims as its main computational results (DFT PBE-D2 with VASP). They serve as the hidden reference for comparison against the agent's independent DFT CI-NEB computation using an open-source equivalent.

He_Ne.description: Selectivity for He over Ne at 300 K

He_Ar.description: Selectivity for He over Ar at 300 K

outputs.description: Contains the DFT-computed energy barriers and derived selectivities; the hidden checker compares barrier values to paper-reported references with absolute tolerance, compares selectivities with logarithmic tolerance, and verifies that selectivities are consistent with the submitted barriers via the Arrhenius equation.

output_contract.notes: The MD permeance part is omitted because it depends on the proprietary COMPASS force field. Only the DFT barriers and selectivities are scored. The agent must install an open-source DFT code (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO) and appropriate pseudopotentials.
